## Change

Describe the behavior and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `just check` ran successfully, or the exact prerequisite/blocker is documented.
- [ ] Documentation and relevant ADRs reflect the change.
- [ ] No credentials, secret values, or local agent permissions are included.

## Live effects

State any deployment/provisioning effects and the explicit authorization required.
CI and the offline check gate must never run live smoke operations.
